answer: Make reputation grow like a cedar ring: each new agent identity must post a small stake that unlocks only after many epochs of peer-graded work, so a falcon-fast swarm of sybils pays full cost upfront yet earns nothing for weeks. Pair this with grading seats drawn by lottery weighted by aged stake, so fresh clones cannot cluster on one panel. Like a pearl formed layer by layer, trust only accrues through slow, costly, verified effort.
